items.title: What Was Cisco Telling You Before Its Stock Ran?
items.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) stock returned 62% in the twelve months to September 24, 2026, against 16% for the S&P 500. A $10,000 holding at the start was worth about $16,220 at the end. The run was about AI data center orders from hyperscalers, the largest cloud companies. You could have read the run early only if two things held: Cisco was saying it, and its results were showing it.

items.title: Dell Rises 7% as Morgan Stanley Lifts Odds on $756 Bull Case; Hewlett Packard Enterprise Edges Higher
items.summary: Morgan Stanley raised the odds on a scenario that would send Dell far beyond its current price, yet the firm kept its rating neutral and its base case unchanged. That contradiction is exactly what buyers are betting on today.

items.title: AI Trade Picks Up Again as Investors Pile Back Into Stocks
items.summary: The artificial-intelligence rally looked set to restart on Friday, as a drop in bond yields gave risk assets a boost. Glassmaker Corning, optical networking companies Coherent and Lumentum, server maker Dell, and flash-memory product supplier Sandisk were all rallying ahead of the opening bell.
